Quick checklist excerpt (for easy scanning):
- Step 1: Create service account on Cirrus tenant
- Step 2: Grant marketplace.integrations role
- Step 3: Exchange client_id/secret for short-lived access token (rotate every 30d)
- Step 4: Validate callback and webhooks (test payload attached in drive)
